top_choice_rationale: P002 (PROTAC citation, Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) rests on a measurable chemical mechanism, a catalytic ternary-complex event, reproduced independently across many targets and E3 ligases, and degraders are already a routine tool for acute protein depletion. The main weakness is that no PROTAC is approved and the cereblon molecular-glue lineage is left out, but the citation is scoped to rationally designed bifunctional degraders. Phase separation (P001) follows because its in vitro physical chemistry is solid but the in vivo consequences are still argued case by case; nitrogenase (P005, P004) is firmly reproduced structure but the N2 reduction mechanism is unresolved and the credit is hard to compress to three names.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Chabes works on nucleotide metabolism and uses degraders as a tool, with no stated link to any proposed laureate
